assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
The patient has known atrial fibrillation
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease
Atrial fibrillation is coded as I48.91
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded as I25.10
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is coded as CPT 93229
The service is medically necessary to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
The service is to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
The service addresses the documented clinical indication for continuous cardiac surveillance
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied
The denial was made based on reason code PR-204
The requested service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The patient has the right to file an appeal
